name: VAMSI MANNE
title: ==SENIOR TEST ENGINEER==  ·  FUNCTIONAL & AUTOMATED TEST FRAMEWORKS  |  Hyderabad

sections.heading: PROFILE SUMMARY
sections.body: Test Engineer with ==6+ years== of experience across ==all phases of the test lifecycle==, ==designing test plans, test procedures, and automated test frameworks== for enterprise web and SaaS products. ==Developed and maintained complex functional, integration, and non-functional tests== and automated frameworks, ==executed complex automated and manual tests==, and ==created and managed performance metrics, defects, test cases, and test results==. Experienced with ==Jenkins-style CI/CD== (Azure DevOps pipelines), ==Selenium/Playwright-style automation==, ==JMeter==, ==Postman/Bruno==, and ==MS SQL Server==, working in ==agile frameworks== and leading test-design standards.

rows: ==Automated test framework development== · Selenium WebDriver · TestNG · BrowserStack LCNC · ACCELQ
==Jenkins pipelines ==[or equivalent CI — fill-in]== · Azure DevOps CI/CD
Functional · Integration · ==Non-functional== · Regression · Smoke · Sanity · Exploratory · API · Security
sections.note: FILL-IN RULE — JD's essentials are Jenkins/XUnit-NUnit, MS SQL Server, and Windows. You have strong Selenium/TestNG framework and CI/CD evidence; the SQL and Jenkins brackets must be filled only with real experience (e.g. running SQL queries for validation). Do not add SOC2/NIST/FedRAMP without genuine exposure.
